title: Count Submatrices with Top-Left Element and Sum Less Than k
summary: Given a 0-indexed integer matrix grid and an integer k, count the submatrices that include the top-left element and have a sum not exceeding k.
statement: Given a 0-indexed integer matrix grid and an integer k, count the submatrices that include the top-left element and have a sum not exceeding k.
constraints: grid is a nonempty rectangular matrix of nonnegative integers.
Count submatrices whose upper-left corner is grid[0][0] and whose sum is at most k.
Each choice of bottom row and right column identifies one candidate.
hints: Every requested submatrix is a prefix rectangle, so one two-dimensional prefix value gives its entire sum.
Build the prefix table row by row and count each cell whose prefix sum is at most k.
The inclusion-exclusion formula equals the sum of exactly rows 0..r-1 and columns 0..c-1, covering every candidate once.
editorial: The inclusion-exclusion formula equals the sum of exactly rows 0..r-1 and columns 0..c-1, covering every candidate once.

tests.explanation: Prefix rectangles ending at the first two cells of row zero and the first two cells of column zero contribute four qualifying sums.
The one-cell, top row, and left column rectangles have sums one, three, and four; the full sum ten is too large.
